name: cyberdastak-opportunities
description: Daily-updated aggregator for Cybersecurity jobs, internships, events, and scholarships in India

scripts.prepare-site: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('site/data',{recursive:true}); ['jobs.json','events.json','scholarships.json','newly-added.json'].forEach(f=>{if(fs.existsSync('data/'+f)) fs.copyFileSync('data/'+f, 'site/data/'+f);}); console.log('Synced data to site/data/');"
scripts.build: npm run fetch && npm run prepare-site
scripts.start: npm run prepare-site && npx serve site

author: CyberDastak
